reason: A more directly targets low friction across the full temperature window through an embedded low-shear solid lubricant and includes an intermediate-temperature test, although it lacks supporting citations and needs tighter load and oxidation-stability boundaries. B improperly extrapolates results from AlCoCrFeNi W-containing BCC coatings at 800 °C to FCC CoCrFeNi, while its evidence reports fluctuating friction and does not support 0.5 at.% W producing precipitates or low friction from room temperature upward.
